$comment: Hand-labelled palms for one test site (tests/accuracy/<site>/ground_truth.geojson). Format: plans/detailed/06-testing.md#ground-truth-format. Cross-file checks (points inside labeled_area.geojson, prefix matches folder, meta.yaml) live in tests/accuracy/gt.py.
title: ground_truth.geojson
description: FeatureCollection of Point features, EPSG:4326, one per palm the labeller could see.

name.description: Optional; QGIS and GDAL write it.

crs.description: Optional legacy member; gt.py checks it names WGS84.

id.description: Optional; QGIS and GDAL write feature ids.

coordinates.description: [lon, lat], WGS84. Crown centre as seen in the orthoimage.

gt_id.description: <site>-gt-NNNN, unique within the site. Use gt.py next-id.

height_class.description: S < 8 m; M 8 to < 15 m; T 15 to < 25 m; X >= 25 m. Edges match palms height_m classes.

height_ref_m.description: CHM maximum within 1.5 m of the point, written by gt.py fill-heights; null where there is no CHM data. Absent or null before fill-heights.

species.description: Species key (for example washingtonia_robusta, or <genus>_sp) or unknown. Same pattern as palms.geojson species.

species_basis.description: Where the species label came from. Never the palmscan prediction.

confidence.description: low = maybe a palm. An unmatched low point is ignored, not a false negative.
